entities.summary: George Lennox Sharman Shackle was an English economist. He made a practical attempt to challenge classical rational choice theory and has been characterised as a "post-Keynesian", though he is influenced as well by Austrian economics. Much of his work is associated with the Dempster–Shafer theory of evidence. G. L. S. Shackle was a performers & entertainers from Cambridge (1903-07-14, Cambridge–1992-03-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
